item.title: It’s crazy that Super Mario Brothers 3 and Super Mario World were only 18 months apart.
item.author: invalid@example.com (entremet)
item.dc:creator: entremet
item.content:encoded: Two of the best platformers of all time, developed by the same team and only 18 months apart. If you look at early dev shots of SMW it looks a lot like SMB3 art wise. It then took a more pastel look. I do love both but give a slight edge to SMB3. It was such a huge jump, no pun intended, in control, design, mechanics.

item.title: Do you think Nintendo will shy away from 3D Metroid games for a long time?
item.author: invalid@example.com (BahamutZero)
item.dc:creator: BahamutZero
item.content:encoded: Like.....Metroid Prime 4 was disappointing man. REALLY disappointing. Critics and players alike. Metroid Dread was great and reviewed great. Metroid Ravenous looks great too. How long until Metroid Prime 5? Or any new 3D Metroid? I think they may have lost their appetite for it, and if this is what we should expect maybe the players too. I wouldn't hate seeing remasters of Metroid Prime 2 and 3. But a new Metroid Prime game? It now feels like we won't see it during the Switch 2 generation.
